Xbox was warned this could happen. Years ago, a Microsoft architect emailed Phil Spencer worried that Xbox's studio empire could turn into a bloodbath. Now the layoffs are here, studios are being cut loose, and the new plan seems to be chasing something even stranger: one billion people a day.
